channel.desc: Romance 2020 Aid worker Hana returns to Luxor and reunites with former lover Sultan, confronting the ghosts of her past and grappling with love and loss as the ancient city forces her to reevaluate her future. Andrea Riseborough, Michael Landes, Sherin Reda, Karim Saleh, Shahira Fahmi, Zeina Durra, Zeina Durra, Shereen Reda.
